verdict.rationale: The Ohio Secretary of State is a government filing service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing interface. The probes show its own hosts return 403 even at robots.txt, and the Gateway and tax pages describe only human web portals behind OHID sign-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
